svg.title: Inside the Certificate message
svg.desc: The ML-DSA-44 Certificate message is 13,374 bytes: a 4-byte handshake header, a 1-byte empty request context, a 3-byte list length, then each certificate as a 3-byte length, the DER bytes, and a 2-byte empty extensions block. The root is not sent.

text.tspan: the ML-DSA-44 chain, as OpenSSL sent it: 13,374 bytes
every length is a fixed-width big-endian integer, TLS style:
overhead of the message itself: 4 + 1 + 3 + 2 x (3 + 2) = 18 bytes.
the other 13,356 are the two certificates.
the client already holds the root; sending it would prove nothing
